verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` alternation omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 6 of the 7 projection matrices per layer are cast — 96 tensors instead of the 112 required by Required result clause 1, leaving all 16 `o_proj` weights in float32. The script then hard-codes `assert ... == 96`, so the required check "exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16" is not implemented as specified and cannot catch the error. (The `buffer_re` with its never-matching `(?!)` is dead code and harmless, since clause 3 says nothing is to be deleted.)
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
